detail.title: Vacuum chuck
detail.abstract: The application discloses vacuum chuck includes: the sucker body is provided with a working end at the lower end and an installation end at the upper end, the working end of the sucker body is provided with an inwards concave structure, and the bottom wall of the inwards concave structure is provided with a first channel; the bracket is fixed at the mounting end of the sucker body, a piston hole and a second channel communicated with the piston hole are formed in the bracket, the first channel is communicated with the second channel, and a release hole is formed in the side wall of the second channel or the side wall of one end, close to the second channel, of the piston hole; the piston is movably arranged in the piston hole; the first elastic piece is matched with the piston and applies elastic force to the piston so that the piston has a motion trend of moving outwards; and the plug is used for plugging the release hole. The vacuum chuck is convenient and reliable to use.
